title: Memory-Efficient Speculative Decoding with Quantized Draft KV Cache
abstract: arXiv:2611.20565v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Speculative decoding reduces generation cost, but it stores two KV caches: one for the target model and one for the draft model. We reduce this extra memory by quantizing the draft cache. The target cache and verifier remain in BF16, so that compression cannot change the target model's final correction rule. We first study how to divide precision between keys and values. A naive per-token quantizer makes keys appear much more sensitive: splitting a 12-bit budget, K8V4 beats K4V8 in acceptance by 10.87pp. However, with grouped per-channel keys, the gap becomes -0.25pp. A controlled Qwen test confirms that changing only the key quantizer can erase or reverse the preferred bit split. Hence, following KIVI, we propose K4V4 quantization with per-channel keys and per-token values. Across six model pairs, our method reduces draft cache memory by 66.20%, and combined memory across both caches by 23.95%. Mean acceptance drops from 57.93% to 57.

translated_title: 基于量化草稿KV缓存的内存高效推测解码
translated_abstract: 推测解码降低了生成成本，但它需要存储两个KV缓存：一个用于目标模型，一个用于草稿模型。我们通过量化草稿缓存来减少这部分额外内存。目标缓存和验证器保持BF16精度，因此压缩不会改变目标模型的最终纠正规则。我们首先研究了如何在键和值之间分配精度。朴素的逐token量化器使键显得敏感得多：在12位预算下，K8V4的接受率比K4V8高出10.87个百分点。然而，采用分组的逐通道键量化后，差距变为-0.25个百分点。一项受控的Qwen测试证实，仅改变键量化器就可以消除或反转优选的位分配方案。因此，遵循KIVI的做法，我们提出采用逐通道键和逐token值的K4V4量化方法。在六个模型对上，我们的方法将草稿缓存内存减少了66.20%，两个缓存的总内存减少了23.95%。平均接受率从57.93%降至57……
tldr: 该论文提出对推测解码中草稿模型的KV缓存进行K4V4量化（逐通道键与逐token值），同时保持目标模型缓存为BF16精度，从而将草稿缓存内存减少66.20%、双缓存总内存减少23.95%，且几乎不影响接受率。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes K4V4 quantization (per-channel keys, per-token values) of the draft model's KV cache in speculative decoding while keeping the target cache in BF16, reducing draft cache memory by 66.20% and total cache memory by 23.95% with negligible impact on acceptance rate.
